services.desc: The design of the Atrium is a thoughtful blend of contemporary and classic elements. Birch wood panels and glass curtain walls are elegantly juxtaposed with the warm, traditional texture of an aged brick corner façade. This blend of materials creates a setting that is both stylish and welcoming. Versatile and spacious, the Atrium can comfortably accommodate up to 220 seated guests or 300 standing visitors. It is an ideal venue for a variety of events. The Atrium offers a unique and appealing environment, ensuring that any event held here feels special and distinctive.
